text:
I checked `replay-bubbles/requirements.md` and rewrote it; the text-check script flagged nothing before or after.

Four changes, all in that file:
- **Title:** it carried the agent role, "(you are a mastermind, on Sonnet, high effort)". The title now says what the task is, and the role sits on its own line below it.
- **Recite:** it is now a link to its readme.
- **Test line:** "speak asked" is plain wording now: the test checks that the speech request for the bubble's first sentence was sent.
- **Law 6:** it now names CLAUDE.md and spells out "one of everything".

I did not link V1, V2 and V3. I found no single page for each, and linking guesses would be worse.

I appended one "rewrote" line to `.claude/skills/clarity/flags.jsonl`.

I reviewed the replay-bubbles work and the verdict is **fix**: the replay feature itself is built and tested, but the phone screenshots are missing and some docs still describe the old behaviour. The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/replay-bubbles/review.md`. I made no code edits.

**What has to change:**
1. **No phone screenshots.** The brief asked for 360×740 shots of V1, V2 and V3 taken through `monorepo.lew42.com` with the phone's user agent. There are none in the task folder or the worktree. The session log says "phone shots read", but the test only shoots at 400×860 into a temporary folder that isn't kept.
2. **Stale docs.** Two lines in the Recite readme (16 and 35) and two in `doc/architecture.md` (39 and 41) still describe tapping as "pause whatever is playing" and call resumable bubbles "the next piece". There is also no decision entry yet for how bubbles are named and remembered.

**What works:**
- **One shared control.** The ▶/⏸ and ↺10 control is one shared component, mounted once in Chat V3 (V2 gets it through V3) and once in the V1 widget.
- **Replay and resume.** Playing a bubble starts from where it last stopped, or from the start. ↺10 steps back about 10 s, and the audio is made again each time rather than stored.
- **Remembered place.** Each bubble's place is kept in memory and in the browser's storage, so it survives a reload.
- **Tests.** There are unit tests for resume-from-word, and one headless test that covers all three views with the speech server stubbed and the live Servex fenced off.

**Observations (notes, not blockers):**
- Tapping a bubble to replay it also throws away other replies that were queued but not yet heard. The brief said the queue rules should stay as they are.
- In V1, one bubble can hold several merged replies. While a later one plays, the button doesn't switch to ⏸, and a tap replays the whole bubble instead of pausing.
- A code comment in `ReciteBubble.js` says each bubble's key is refreshed when the control is mounted, but it isn't. After a fix edits a bubble's opening words, the play button can show the wrong state until the next tap.
- The new CSS class names don't use the module's `audio-recite-` prefix.
- The new `ReciteBubble` class has no instances, so its class page has nothing live to show.
- `files.jsonl` picked up a leftover temp-file entry.

The feature works but needs fixes before it lands: I wrote `review.md` in the task folder with `verdict: fix`, three must-fix findings and five notes. I made no code edits.

**What works:** each of V1, V2 and V3 has one shared control under the assistant replies, with ▶/⏸ and ↺10. Tapping a reply's text plays or pauses that reply, and play picks up where it last stopped. The stopping place is kept in memory and in the browser. The headless test (all three views) and the unit tests are there and fenced from the live Servex. I didn't rerun any tests; this comes from reading the diff and the three phone screenshots.

**Must fix:**
1. **The phone screenshots won't land.** The three shots (360×740) are in the worktree, but `.gitignore` ignores every `shots/` folder, so they aren't in commit 59583a689. Nothing records that they were taken through `monorepo.lew42.com` with the phone's user agent either.
2. **V2 and V3 squeeze the reply text at phone width.** A V2/V3 reply lays out its parts side by side, so the control becomes a third column next to the text instead of sitting under it. In `phone-v3.png` the reply wraps at about half the bubble's width, with an empty strip about 100 px wide down the right side.
3. **`audio/Recite/doc/architecture.md` is still out of date at lines 39, 41 and 43.** It says per-bubble replay is "the next piece", and it points to a "bubble-toolbar piece" that the readme's to-do list no longer has. One heading says "'Tap to hear it' is not true yet" while its own text says it now is. The first review flagged this and it was only half fixed.

**Notes:**
- **V1 shot:** it shows a hand-built test chat pasted onto the Start page, not V1 where it really lives.
- **Highlight:** if a new reply arrives while an old one is replaying, the highlight can light up a different reply that opens with the same words.
- **Update cost:** the ▶/⏸ update runs about four times a second and checks every reply bubble each time.
- **No live instances:** the new class keeps no instances, so its class page has nothing live to show.
- **Not merged yet:** the merge and the 3-line report to vscode-mastermind haven't happened.

The verdict is **fix**. The feature works and matches the owner's asks, but two small things are still wrong. The report is in `replay-bubbles/review.md`.

**Must change:**
1. **The phone shots won't be committed.** The three 360×740 PNGs are in the worktree, but `.gitignore:184` ignores PNGs under `ai/`. Commit 1fe558d43 holds only `phone-shots/readme.md`, and that readme says the shots "live here". They need `git add -f` or a tracked folder.
2. **One doc line contradicts itself.** `audio/Recite/doc/architecture.md:41` now says "'Tap to hear it' is true", but the same line still says a tap "never replays that specific update". That middle clause should go.

**Worth a look:**
- **Wrong host for the shots.** They were taken on the branch's own dev server, not `monorepo.lew42.com` as the brief asked; the shots' readme explains why. One shot on that host after the merge would prove the brief's path.
- **Earlier layout fix works.** `phone-v3.png` shows ▶ and ↺10 on their own row under each reply now.
- **Temp-file lines in the index.** `audio/Recite/files.jsonl` gained two lines for a temp file.
- **Highlight can still light the wrong bubble.** If a new reply arrives during a replay, an older bubble with the same opening words can light up instead.
- **No live instances to show.** `ReciteBubble` has only static members, so its class page shows none; low stakes.
- **Merge and report not done.** The branch isn't merged yet, and the 3-line report to vscode-mastermind hasn't been sent.

Requirements 1–4 are met, and 6 is met except for that one doc line. The headless test covering V1, V2 and V3 and the unit tests are in the diff; I read them but didn't run them.

I checked the landed task `replay-bubbles` and rewrote it in place. Two things failed:

- **Outcome:** it was one paragraph with no per-ask proof. I appended a new outcome to `session.jsonl`. It lists each ask from the requirements as `- [x]` with proof beside it. The phone-shots line says the shots were taken on the branch server, not yet on `monorepo.lew42.com`.
- **`review.md`:** it was 543 words. I removed findings 1, 2, 4 and 8, which are already fixed, and added one line saying so. It is now 416 words. The text-check still flags "no picture", which I left alone because a review has nothing to draw.

I did not shoot the pages, so the three-question look at the whole screen was not done. The task changed no site pages, and the landing's own layout check was skipped for that reason. I also left the open review notes (retake one shot on the deployed host, `focus_el` highlight edge case) for the owner of the task. The `rewrote` line is in `flags.jsonl`.
